# Frank Meltke

> German inventor, founder and CEO of contraco, guest lecturer at Kyung Hee University in Seoul, and Insight Panelist for BBC Global Minds. Pioneer in search systems and AI transformation since 1998.

Frank Meltke founded contraco in 1998. He holds patent DE10313420A1 (2003) for a search relevance system combining multiple search engines with prioritised result scoring, filed when Google was five years old. He serves as guest lecturer at Kyung Hee University (경희대학교) MIS programme in Seoul alongside executives from SK Telecom, Samsung, Oracle Korea, and LG. He is an Insight Panelist for BBC Global Minds. He served as CEO of Weltmeister Akkordeon Manufaktur (2018-2024).

## About contraco

contraco is a premium transformation consultancy founded in 1998. It combines strategic clarity, technological intelligence, and psychological depth. The proprietary methodology is The Resonance Method. contraco domains: contraco.net (English), contraco.de (German), contraco.ru (Russian), contraco.co.kr (Korean).
